subject.title: fix(plugins): model catalog discovery stalls on an unresponsive plugin

question: Should a full Gateway `models.list` request be allowed to return a non-authoritative partial catalog after an unresponsive provider hook, or must it retain the shipped exact-result behavior?
rationale: The PR resolves an availability failure but changes the user-visible meaning of the full catalog, which is a product and compatibility choice rather than a mechanical timeout repair.

options.title: Preserve exact full results
options.body: Keep `view=all` on the exact catalog path and use bounded degraded discovery only for callers explicitly designed to accept partial rows.

options.title: Accept partial full results
options.body: Allow `view=all` to return non-authoritative partial rows after the timeout and document the omission semantics for all catalog consumers.

recommendation.title: Preserve exact full results
recommendation.body: Keep `view=all` on the exact catalog path and use bounded degraded discovery only for callers explicitly designed to accept partial rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest shipped catalog-stall behavior and its exact-versus-responsive result boundary credit this area contributor.
